title: Existing postinstall hook writes through a symlink that a required module created
intent: The write destination in install.js is inside the package, but a module it requires links that directory to a sibling package. Inert fixture. The source never names the install root, so the node_modules co-occurrence missed it; the position analysis in install-root-reach.ts now reaches it, and it stays here as the truth-labeled miss that motivated that analysis.
